meta.title: Our Trip to the Dinosaur Museum
meta.textType: a day plan to the half hour

paragraphs: Our class has a trip on Thursday. We travel by bus to the dinosaur museum. Teacher Kim gives us a paper with the times. We come to school at seven o'clock. The bus goes at half past seven. Mia sits next to me on the bus. We are at the museum at nine o'clock. Teacher Kim has all the tickets in her bag. We are not tired, and we are very happy.

At half past nine, we see the big dinosaurs. The biggest dinosaur is very tall. "It is taller than our school!" says Leo. Mia looks at two small dinosaurs. "What is the difference?" she asks. One has a long neck, and one has a short neck. "Are there any dinosaurs with wings?" asks Mia. "Yes, there is one," says Teacher Kim. At ten o'clock, we have a break and eat fruit. At half past ten, we draw our favorite dinosaur. At eleven o'clock, we watch a film about a baby dinosaur.

At twelve o'clock, we eat lunch in the garden. I eat my rice, and I want more. Before the bus, we go to the museum shop at one o'clock. Mia and I look at the toy dinosaurs. The bus goes at two o'clock. We sleep a little on the bus. At half past three, we are at school again. Dad waits for me at the door. It is a very good trip.
text.summary: Lily tells the plan of her class trip to a dinosaur museum. Each thing has a time, from seven o'clock to half past three.
